outputs.with:
**Newsletter: Shifts Open at 10 AM on October 6**

Dear Shift Workers,

We are excited to announce a significant change in our schedule. Starting October 6, our shifts will begin at 10 AM. This shift change is not only beneficial for those who work long hours but also for those who prefer the early morning start.

This change allows us to provide more flexibility to our team members, ensuring that everyone can start their day with the energy and focus they need. Whether you're a morning person or enjoy the early start, this new schedule is designed to accommodate everyone.

We invite you to drop in and experience the new shift schedule. We are excited to have you on board and are looking forward to seeing you at 10 AM on October 6.

Thank you for your continued support and partnership.

Sincerely,  
[Your Name]  
Founder
